component.name: Kog
component.summary: Play conventional audio, MIDI, chiptunes, trackers, and game music

description.p: Kog is a cross-platform local music player with a Qt Quick interface and broad format support, including conventional audio, MIDI synthesis, tracker modules, chiptunes, and game-audio formats.
Roland MT-32 and SC-55 emulation is supported with compatible user-supplied ROMs. Kog does not distribute proprietary ROM data.
